description: Negative (and boundary) cases for signing.md section 7. Every case starts from signing-basic.json and replaces only the members it names: `now` (the receiver's clock; default = `created` of the base), `request` members, `headers` members (content_digest, signature_input, signature), `key_record_txt`. `expected` is `valid` or the problem identifier the receiver must answer with.

cases.name: created-at-window-edge
cases.description: Receiver clock exactly 5 minutes after `created`: still inside the window.

cases.name: created-expired
cases.description: Receiver clock 5 minutes and 1 second after `created`.

cases.name: created-in-future
cases.description: Receiver clock 5 minutes and 1 second before `created`.

cases.name: wrong-digest
cases.description: Content-Digest is a well-formed sha-256 digest of other content.

cases.name: revoked-key
cases.description: The key record has an empty p= tag.

cases.name: other-key
cases.description: The key record holds a different public key (RFC 8032 section 7.1 TEST 2).

cases.name: other-authority
cases.description: The request is replayed to a different receiver host.

cases.name: other-idempotency-key
cases.description: The Idempotency-Key header was replaced after signing.

cases.name: other-tag
cases.description: No signature carries tag idmx-v1, so the request counts as unsigned.

cases.name: foreign-sender-domain
cases.description: A correct signature by s1._idmxkey.other.example, published with the same public key; the envelope `from` is in sender.example, not in the signing domain.
